title: J&K Sports Council hails Chandeep Singh’s historic World Para Taekwondo title

ai.summary: The Jammu and Kashmir Sports Council celebrated Chandeep Singh's World Para Taekwondo gold medal win as a historic achievement for the region and Indian sports.

facts.claim: The Jammu & Kashmir Sports Council extended congratulations to Chandeep Singh on clinching the heavyweight gold medal at the World Para Taekwondo Championship in Muju, South Korea.
facts.quote: Jammu & Kashmir Sports Council on Tuesday extended congratulations to Chandeep Singh on clinching the heavyweight gold medal at the World Para Taekwondo Championship in Muju, South Korea.

facts.claim: Chandeep, previously a two-time world championship silver medallist, has now captured the coveted world crown—a landmark achievement for para-taekwondo in Jammu and Kashmir and a proud moment for Indian sport.
facts.quote: Previously a two-time world championship silver medallist, Chandeep, as per a statement issued, has now captured the coveted world crown—a landmark achievement for para-taekwondo in Jammu and Kashmir and a proud moment for Indian sport.

facts.claim: Tazayun Mukhtar Kawos, Secretary of the J&K Sports Council, said "His success is a moment of immense pride for Jammu and Kashmir and an inspiration for aspiring athletes, particularly para-athletes, demonstrating how dedication, resilience and hard work can translate into success at the highest level of international sport."
facts.quote: Tazayun Mukhtar Kawos, Secretary of the J&K Sports Council, said "His success is a moment of immense pride for Jammu and Kashmir and an inspiration for aspiring athletes, particularly para-athletes, demonstrating how dedication, resilience and hard work can translate into success at the highest level of international sport."

facts.claim: The J&K Sports Council recognised the years of rigorous training behind Chandeep’s global performances and acknowledged the steadfast support of his family, mentors, and well-wishers throughout his competitive journey, wishing him continued glory on the international stage.
